content: {"praised":["Lady Killer is the best film on the set.","Cagney and Mae Clark deliver strong performances.","Pre‑code gangster films are still great to watch.","Fast‑paced comedy keeps the crime stories entertaining.","The set offers good entertainment with classic stars."],"criticized":["Picture Snatcher and Mayor of Hell are weak links.","Cagney is underutilized in Smart Money.","The set focuses on second‑tier Warner titles.","Some films feel less compelling than earlier volumes.","The overall quality is lower than previous volumes."]}
